text.p: Lindsay Manufacturing Co said Thursday it voted a three-for-two stock split payable on March 10 to holders of record March 3.
It currently has about 6.4 million shares outstanding.
Earlier, at its annual meeting, Lindsay said shareholders approved an increase in the number of authorized shares of common stock to 25 million from 10 million.
Following the split, there will be about 9.6 million shares of common stock outstanding.

This is Lindsay's second three-for-two stock split in just over a year, the company noted. In addition, it has an ongoing stock repurchase program and has bought back 870,000 of its outstanding shares since November 1994 and has authorization to repurchase about 940,000 additional shares (or 1,410,000 shares adjusted for the stock split).
Of the increase in authorized shares, chairman Gary Parker said, "This is yet another tool for management to draw upon as we work to continue to enhance sharheolder value."
Lindsay produces center pivot and lateral move irrigation equipment and large diameter steel tubing.
